rows.note: The Pripyat (Polesian) marshes, drained only from the 1960s, so modern MODIS reads them as farmland: the regions with at least two thirds of their tiles in the Polesian lowland (Pinsk and Brest; Mozyr and Gomel; Kovel's Volhynian Polesie)
The Ob swamps of western Siberia: the western half of Khanty-Mansiy, whose eastern half the MODIS rule already reads as marsh
